## AC2 evidence — per-pair node counts reconcile

Measured ahead of the close, because the sibling story `fb5f-54fd-96cc-4105`
failed its completion gate on this exact criterion with the work already
correct and only the evidence missing.

Method — one collection pass per tree, counted per file, so the before and
after numbers cannot drift between separate pytest invocations:

- **before** = parent commit `bd79355895735680809734d038f4a556aaef77c1`,
  collecting both members of each pair
- **after** = this story's commit `db0fb9c44f9`, collecting the surviving
  base alone
- both with `-m ""` so no marker deselection distorts the count, and
  `-p no:randomly` for a stable order

| base module (tests/scripts/) | base | heldout | before | after | |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| test_backfill_bug_class.py | 2 | 5 | 7 | 7 | OK |
| test_backfill_caused_by.py | 2 | 3 | 5 | 5 | OK |
| test_backfill_complexity_clone.py | 1 | 3 | 4 | 4 | OK |
| test_canary_bridge.py | 28 | 32 | 60 | 60 | OK |
| test_check_adr_numbers.py | 4 | 10 | 14 | 14 | OK |
| test_check_config_ownership.py | 7 | 23 | 30 | 30 | OK |
| test_check_config_reads.py | 5 | 18 | 23 | 23 | OK |
| test_migrate_success_criteria.py | 2 | 25 | 27 | 27 | OK |
| test_normalize_ci_conclusion_port.py | 13 | 12 | 25 | 25 | OK |
| test_run_reconcile_bridge.py | 5 | 26 | 31 | 31 | OK |

**10 pairs, 0 mismatches. Totals: 226 before, 226 after.**

Every merged base collects exactly the sum of its two predecessors, so the
merge neither dropped nor duplicated a test node.

The `test_run_reconcile_bridge.py` row is worth reading alongside the
bare-repository fix recorded earlier on this ticket: the count is unchanged at
31, confirming that routing the 10 call sites through `bare_git` altered how
those tests address the repository without adding, removing, or renaming a
single node.
